subject.text: The whole team cannot open the design app

description.text: Since the 1st, the DesainPro app refuses to open on every laptop in our team.
The message says: 'Team license has expired. Contact the license administrator.'
Other apps and the internet work normally.
A friend offered a free activation code from a forum, can we use it?

history.text: The DesainPro license was bought by Procurement, valid until 30 September.

explanation: The error message shows the team license has expired, and renewing it needs the license admin and Procurement, not a desk technician. Escalate the ticket, and do not use an unofficial activation code from a forum.
hints: Read the error message carefully. Who usually handles licenses?
A technician cannot buy a license alone. Official licenses are handled by the license admin and Procurement.
